# Koi

> Open source AEO tool. Koi asks ChatGPT, Gemini, Google AI Mode and Google AI Overviews what a product's buyers ask, every day, and shows whether the product is cited or mentioned, who is recommended instead, and a markdown brief the founder's agent can act on.

- License: MIT
- Pricing: per tracked prompt, from €29 a month for 15 prompts to €449 a month for 500. Tax included. Every engine and feature is included.
- Brands: unlimited on every plan; they share the plan's prompts.
- First check: free, no card needed. Then a 7-day trial.
- Self-hosting: free software. Live answers use your own Cloro account.

## Start

- [Agent setup instructions](https://getkoi.co/SKILL.md): paste into a coding agent to set up Koi and run the first check.
- [Sign up in the browser](https://app.getkoi.co/sign-up)

## Compare

Each page puts Koi next to one tool, with prices and features checked on that company's own pages and where the other tool is ahead.

- [Koi vs Profound](https://getkoi.co/alternatives/profound): Profound sells Enterprise plans at a custom price, with up to ten engines.
- [Koi vs Peec AI](https://getkoi.co/alternatives/peec-ai): Peec AI starts at $95 a month for 50 prompts on three engines.
- [Koi vs Otterly.AI](https://getkoi.co/alternatives/otterly): Otterly.AI starts at €29 a month for 16 prompts before tax; MCP from €189.
- [Koi vs Elmo](https://getkoi.co/alternatives/elmo): both MIT licensed; Elmo has more engines and checks, Koi has unlimited brands.
- [Open source AEO tools](https://getkoi.co/open-source-aeo-tools): Koi, Elmo, GetCito, Limelit Open, OneGlanse, GEO/AEO Tracker and Ansvisor.
